reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, so a sachet I just grab in the evening with no counting is the part that gets me. $24.99 for the first box is low enough to try on impulse, and the named lab report answers my usual 'is it tested or just marketing' question.
objection: Made in China, and I only have their word that the report matches my batch until I actually scan the QR code. If the report looks fake or generic I'm out.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code did not open a real report from a lab I can look up, or if the price was above about $35 for one box.
